_source: NASA/JPL Horizons API (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/), satellite ephemeris mar099, queried 2026-11-15: EPHEM_TYPE=ELEMENTS, CENTER=500@499 (Mars centre), REF_PLANE=FRAME (ICRF), 2024-01-01 to 2050-01-01 TDB every 5 days. Each row: [longitude of ascending node OM (deg, unwrapped), inclination IN (deg), argument of latitude W+TA (deg, unwrapped so it can be interpolated linearly)]. aKm: mean semi-major axis.
